Dear bestie,

Happy birthday, Trishi — CEO of dramatic reactions, random chaos, and somehow still being everyone's favourite. 💗

Some people just make ordinary days feel like stories worth keeping, and you're one of them. Every random chat, goofy joke, unexpected pep talk, and moment we spend together ends up becoming something I treasure.

I'm wishing you a year full of bright surprises, peaceful mornings, new adventures, and the courage to go after anything you dream about. I hope you see yourself with the same kindness you show everyone around you.

Life changes so quickly, but the little things stay: laughing at absolutely nothing, sending the most chaotic messages, and knowing there's someone who gets the joke. I hope we collect a million more moments like those.

Today is your official excuse to demand cake, take 847 photos, and act like the entire universe is your personal fan club. Honestly, the universe has had practice. 🎂✨

One complaint: your talent for being late to replies but early to the drama needs to be studied by scientists. I built you a WHOLE website, so please act impressed for at least five minutes. 🙄💕

Stay iconic, birthday menace. Love you, bestie ♡
